subject.title: fix(doctor): preserve allowlist entries for version-bound runtime plugins during stale config scan

question: Should an uninstalled `codex` entry in `plugins.allow` be preserved indefinitely by every doctor stale-config repair, or only while a version-bound upgrade/backfill migration can prove continuing Codex runtime intent?
rationale: The patch makes a compatibility-sensitive policy choice: it protects affected upgrades, but it also changes generic stale cleanup for all future doctor runs even when no configured route needs Codex.

options.title: Bound preservation to migration intent
options.body: Preserve or restore `codex` only when upgrade/backfill state or configured Codex runtime ownership proves it is required, leaving normal stale cleanup intact.

options.title: Make Codex permanently non-stale
options.body: Accept a permanent exception for version-bound runtime plugin IDs and add focused tests and user-visible documentation defining that allowlist contract.

options.title: Move the fix to convergence
options.body: Do not change stale cleanup; instead ensure post-update convergence installs the version-matched plugin or emits a blocking actionable repair before the allowlist is scanned.

recommendation.title: Bound preservation to migration intent
recommendation.body: Preserve or restore `codex` only when upgrade/backfill state or configured Codex runtime ownership proves it is required, leaving normal stale cleanup intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal spans Codex route migration, runtime collection, and plugin enablement policy.
